name: Orthogonal Opacity Map Creation
definition: Creation of an orthogonal opacity map involves projecting the frame buffer to an object-aligned plane and downsampling the result to reduce resolution and transfer costs.
summary: Orthogonal Opacity Map Creation projects the frame buffer onto an orthogonal plane and uses multi-pass averaging to generate a low-resolution occlusion mask, differing from hierarchical approaches by using a fixed-resolution strategy.
